en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a canal or watercourse lined with stone walls running between tall, old town buildings. Several women and children stand or kneel along the edge of the water, washing clothes or working, some under umbrellas for shade. In the background are multi‑story houses with shutters and balconies, and a few pedestrians walking along the path beside the canal. The image has printed text at the top left indicating the location.
